answer: A newcomer stakes a refundable 300 POA bond for 100 days, so one fake identity costs 300 POA, and a farm cannot share one bond across a thousand keys. Its first ten jobs are carved into a public cedar ledger buyers read before paying, so copied history shows at once. A willow check lands with no warning: three auditors drawn by lot replay one finished job live. Each verified job earns an ivory seal only the paying client can stamp; a forged seal burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
